name: The Back Room
tagline: Pizzeria by day, something else by night
description: Your team runs a pizzeria in the mall: dough, sauce, cheese, oven, drinks, customers at the counter. In the evening the rude ones stand under the red lamp, and there is a button under the counter. Whatever falls down, the grinder in the cellar turns into meat for the most expensive pizza. The patrol comes by when you least expect it.
